freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 新用户注册即送 49 元额度，创建 CSGShip API Key 再送 100 元，合计 149 元（具体额度与有效期以控制台为准）。平台为 OpenAI 兼容 LLM 网关，聚合 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash / V4-Pro、GLM-5.3-Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash / Max、MiniMax 等国模，按 token 计费、价格较低（如 GLM-5.3-Flash 输入 ¥0.88 / 百万 tokens，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 输入 ¥2.2 / 百万 tokens）。
freeTierSummary.en: New users receive ¥49 in credits at signup and another ¥100 for creating a CSGShip API key — ¥149 total (exact quota and validity are shown in the console). An OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway aggregating DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash / V4-Pro, GLM-5.3-Flash, Qwen3.8-Flash / Max and MiniMax at low per-token prices (e.g. GLM-5.3-Flash input ¥0.88, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash input ¥2.2 per million tokens).

zh-CN: 打开 https://opencsg.com 注册 OpenCSG 账号，新用户注册即送 49 元额度
在控制台创建 CSGShip API Key，额外获赠 100 元，合计 149 元（具体额度与有效期以控制台为准）
API Key 明文仅创建时显示一次，请立即保存
Base URL 填 https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1，模型填平台模型 ID（如 deepseek-v4.1-flash）；公开模型清单见 https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1/models
en: Open https://opencsg.com and sign up for an OpenCSG account — new users receive ¥49 in credits
Create a CSGShip API key in the console to receive another ¥100, ¥149 in total (the exact quota and validity are shown in the console)
The key plaintext is shown only once — save it immediately
Use https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1 as the base URL with platform model ids (e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash); the public model list is at https://ai.space.opencsg.com/v1/models
